claude_proposed_widenings.name: force_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Effect 3 forces the cursed target to take the Dodge action on its turn if it fails a save. No existing atom forces a creature to spend its action on a specific standard action kind. This is mechanically distinct from apply_condition (which doesn't mandate action choice) and grant_extra_action (which grants, not forces).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: In combat, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.abilityFilter (choice variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Effect 1 applies Disadvantage on ability checks AND saving throws made with a caster-chosen ability. The surface has saveAbilityFilter (fixed ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<Ability>) for saves only, and no abilityFilter at all for ability checks. A cast-time ability picker variant is needed to express 'choose one of the six abilities at cast time' covering both check and save rolls.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one ability. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.attackTargetFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Effect 2 gives the target Disadvantage on attack rolls specifically against the caster. The existing attackerTypeFilter narrows by the attacker's creature type, not by the intended victim of the attack. A new filter scoping the rider to 'attacks whose target is [caster]' is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_caster_deals_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Effect 4 fires whenever the caster deals damage to the target via attack roll OR spell. The existing on_caster_attack_hit trigger only covers landed attack rolls; spell damage has no trigger variant. A broader trigger covering any caster damage delivery (attack or spell) is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell, the target takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration upcast kind-change (concentration → timed / permanent)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Bestow Curse's upcast scaling doesn't just change the duration amount — at L5+ the spell stops requiring Concentration entirely, becoming a timed or permanent Duration. DurationValue.upcastTiers only supports amount changes within a fixed duration kind. No surface mechanism can flip the Duration kind (and concentration flag) as a function of slot level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you use a level 5+ spell slot, the spell doesn't require Concentration, and the duration becomes 8 hours (level 5-6 slot) or 24 hours (level 7-8 slot). If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled.
